description: This file defines the ConduitContext class, a DbContext implementation for Entity Framework Core, representing the database context for the Conduit application. It configures entity relationships, including composite primary keys and delete behaviors, and provides transaction control methods.

classes.name: ConduitContext
classes.description: The Entity Framework Core database context for Conduit, managing entity sets and configuring relationships including composite keys and delete behaviors, as well as transaction management.

methods.name: OnModelCreating
methods.description: Configures the entity relationships and composite primary keys for the database model.

methods.name: BeginTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction if none is active, considering in-memory database context.

methods.name: CommitTransaction
methods.description: Commits the current database transaction, with error handling and disposal.

methods.name: RollbackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction and disposes of it.
